reasons.A: Right period register and semicolon joins, but longer, smoother cumulative sentences and a showy exclamation plus 'multitudinous industry'/'habitualness' tip towards caricature rather than the author's terse, compressed movement.
reasons.B: Closest movement: short, paradoxical assertions ('a privacy within a privacy', 'the confession of a man who is not there to confess') alternating with balanced clauses, grave assertive stance, archaic touches used sparingly.
reasons.C: Modern plain register with 'I do not think', 'Consider', 'dressed up as insight' and a closing appeal; the diction and conversational, reader-facing stance are far from the author's elliptical Victorian gravity.
